descriptions.zh:
在识别出一种潜在的未开智候选者后，我们的§Y创世方舟§!便开始了对§Y创世保护区§!的基因提升流程，并为之设立了必须的空间。

§Y[THIS.GetName]§!上的殖民地已经准备好观测、以及对这一新兴物种的发展进行引导。
descriptions.en:
After identifying a potential pre-sapient candidate, our §YGenesis Ark§! began the process of genetic uplifting and established the needed space for a §YGenesis Preserve§!.

The colony of §Y[THIS.GetName]§! is ready to observe and guide this nascent species' development.

descriptions.zh:
我们的§Y创世方舟§!在召集了所有当地的未开智物种后，开始为它们建立一个§Y创世保护区§!。

§Y[THIS.GetName]§!上的殖民地已经准备好观测、以及对这一新兴物种的发展进行引导。
descriptions.en:
After gathering the native pre-sapient species, our §YGenesis Ark§! began creating a §YGenesis Preserve§! for them.

The colony of §Y[THIS.GetName]§! is ready to observe and guide this nascent species' development.

descriptions.zh:
在向导的不懈努力下，我们完成了§Y[Root.GetName]§!上的提升项目。我们已经将§Y[From.GetName]§!转变为一个完全智慧物种，而他们曾经称之为家园的§Y创世保护区§!已经被改造成了一座§Y创世纪念碑§!。

它将永远是这个物种进化成就的不朽见证。
descriptions.en:
After our guides' unceasing dedication, we have completed the uplifting project on §Y[Root.GetName]§!. We have transitioned the §Y[From.GetName]§! into a fully sapient species, and the §YGenesis Preserve§!, which they once called home, has been transformed into a §YGenesis Monument§!.

It will forever stand as an enduring testament to the achievement that was the evolution of this species.
